criterion: which type of entity the encyclopedia article describes

categories.name: Plant
categories.definition: A living organism of the kind exemplified by trees, shrubs, herbs, grasses, ferns, and mosses.

categories.name: Animal
categories.definition: A living organism that feeds on organic matter, typically having specialized sense organs and nervous system.

categories.name: Person
categories.definition: An individual human being.

categories.name: Building
categories.definition: A structure with a roof and walls, such as a house, school, or factory.

categories.name: Location
categories.definition: A particular place or position.

categories.name: Company
categories.definition: A commercial business.

categories.name: Event
categories.definition: A thing that happens, especially one of importance.

categories.name: Publication
categories.definition: A book, journal, or other work that is published.

categories.name: Vehicle
categories.definition: A thing used for transporting people or goods, especially on land, such as a car, truck, or cart.

categories.name: Organization
categories.definition: An organized group of people with a particular purpose, such as a business or government department.

categories.name: River
categories.definition: A large natural stream of water flowing in a channel to the sea, a lake, or another river.

categories.name: Mountain
categories.definition: A large natural elevation of the earth's surface rising abruptly from the surrounding level.

categories.name: Album
categories.definition: A collection of recordings issued as a single item on CD, record, or another medium.

categories.name: Film
categories.definition: A story or event recorded by a camera as a set of moving images and shown in a theater or on television.

categories.name: Book
categories.definition: A written or printed work consisting of pages glued or sewn together along one side and bound in covers.

categories.name: School
categories.definition: An institution for educating children.

categories.name: Historical Event
categories.definition: An event that has occurred in the past and is significant in history.

categories.name: Art
categories.definition: The expression or application of human creative skill and imagination, typically in a visual form such as painting or sculpture.

categories.name: Sport
categories.definition: An activity involving physical exertion and skill in which an individual or team competes against another or others for entertainment.

categories.name: Technology
categories.definition: The application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry.

categories.name: Music
categories.definition: Vocal or instrumental sounds (or both) combined in such a way as to produce beauty of form, harmony, and expression of emotion.

categories.name: Government
categories.definition: The governing body of a nation, state, or community.

categories.name: Transportation
categories.definition: The action of transporting someone or something or the process of being transported.

categories.name: Military
categories.definition: The armed forces of a country.

categories.name: Religion
categories.definition: The belief in and worship of a superhuman controlling power, especially a personal God or gods.

categories.name: Science
categories.definition: The intellectual and practical activity encompassing the systematic study of the structure and behavior of the physical and natural world through observation and experiment.

categories.name: Political Entity
categories.definition: An organization or unit that has political responsibilities and powers.

categories.name: Cultural Entity
categories.definition: An entity that is significant in the culture of a society.
